description: Columbus, MS — Today, District Attorney and U.S. Senate candidate Scott Colom announced the endorsement of 17 mayors from communities across Mississippi, along with former Tupelo Mayor Jason Shelton, growing the coalition of current and former elected officials backing his campaign to more than 50 statewide.
